recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Follow up only if a human identifies a separate currently distributed STU3 package mirror that still contains the obsolete build.fhir.org binding URL.
issue_request: FHIR-19563 was an Applied/Persuasive OO change request for STU3. It reported that the STU3 DeviceRequest base profile's intent binding used http://build.fhir.org/valueset-request-intent.html and requested http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/request-intent instead, including the STU3 validation package/downloads page.
initial_application: No commit mentioning FHIR-19563 was found, consistent with Jira's resolution that the issue appeared already fixed. Git history shows commit c82cf3a67bd corrected source/devicerequest/devicerequest-spreadsheet.xml on 2018-07-18 by replacing the build.fhir.org RequestIntent URL with http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/request-intent. The stale generated source/release3/profiles-resources.xml artifact still contained the old URL until it was removed from core source by 5c0494aacf during the 2020 UTG/core-source cleanup.
additional_context: DeviceRequest is active in the current build via source/fhir.ini, and source/devicerequest/structuredefinition-DeviceRequest.xml binds DeviceRequest.intent to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/request-intent. Direct checks of the current STU3 publication surface at hl7.org/fhir/STU3 found devicerequest.profile.json, profiles-resources.xml/json, and definitions.xml/json all have zero occurrences of the bad build.fhir.org URL and contain the canonical URL. Zulip searches found no relevant discussion; Confluence refs found OO January 2020 minutes pages including the issue in the DeviceRequest block-vote trail without conflicting guidance.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit is needed because both the current authoritative source and the current STU3 publication/download artifacts already satisfy the requested correction.
